description: Eight digital boolean gates: two AND, two NOT, two OR and two XOR. An input reads at +1V or above, negative voltage is ignored, and every output is either 0V or +5V

inputs.text: One of the two inputs of an AND gate, whose output is +5V only while both of its inputs are on
The input of a NOT gate, whose output is +5V while this input is off
One of the two inputs of an OR gate, whose output is +5V while either input is on
One of the two inputs of an XOR gate, whose output is +5V while exactly one of its inputs is on

outputs.text: The output of an AND gate, at +5V while both of its inputs are on and 0V otherwise
The output of a NOT gate, at +5V while its input is off and 0V while its input is on
The output of an OR gate, at +5V while either of its inputs is on and 0V while both are off
The output of an XOR gate, at +5V while exactly one of its inputs is on and 0V while both are on or both are off

notes: white sockets are inputs and black sockets are outputs
menu: Use 5 Volts levels — makes every gate output 0V or +5V
Use 10 Volts levels — makes every gate output 0V or +10V
